title: User Onboarding Experience
definition: The overall experience new users have when interacting with CADMIES, from installation to initial use.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine going to a new restaurant. The user onboarding experience is like the welcome and guidance you receive when you first walk in. It helps you understand what to do and what to expect.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The user onboarding experience involves several aspects, such as installation instructions, interface design, and guidance for new users. It aims to minimize confusion and maximize usability.
difficulty_levels.expert: The user onboarding experience in CADMIES is a critical aspect of the system's usability and accessibility. Poor onboarding can lead to user frustration and abandonment. Good onboarding, on the other hand, can create a positive first impression and increase user engagement. The user onboarding experience in CADMIES also reflects broader principles of user-centered design, such as minimizing cognitive load and providing clear feedback.

extra_fields.insight: A well-designed user onboarding experience can significantly improve the usability and appeal of CADMIES.
